reason: Strawberry cheesecake matcha and a torched meringue hot chocolate right at my subway exit are exactly the kind of thing I'd post, so I'll try one or two. But at $8.50 on my budget it's a treat for the photo, not my daily coffee. My usual place keeps that.
objection: $8.50 for a latte is a lot when I make $26k, and once I've posted it there's not much reason to keep paying that over my regular spot.
would_change_my_mind: A drink of the week that really changes and looks great, so I have something new to post, or a cheaper smaller size of the signature drinks around $6.
